module rtlpp_07664(
    input clock,		
    input reset,		
    input run,		    
    output busy,		
    output start,		
    output stop	        
);

reg [4:0] state;

always @(posedge clock or posedge reset)
  if (reset)
    state <= 5'd0;
  else begin
    case (state)
      5'd0: if (run)
              state <= 5'd1;
      default: if (state == 5'd17)
                 state <= 5'd0;
               else
                 state <= state + 1;
    endcase
  end

assign start = run;
assign stop  = (state == 5'd17); 
assign busy  = (state != 5'd0);

endmodule
